exposure: BMI z-score trajectories from birth to 24 years of age
outcome: Pre-bronchodilator spirometry (FEV1/FVC ratio z-scores, FEV1, FVC)
Lung clearance index (from multiple-breath nitrogen washout)
cohort: The study participants were 3204 individuals (78.4% of the original cohort) from the Swedish BAMSE birth cohort who had four or more BMI z-scores recorded from birth to 24 years of age.
finding: Accelerated increasing and persistent high BMI trajectories from birth to early adulthood were associated with reduced lung function and elevated lung clearance index by 24 years, while accelerated resolving BMI showed no such impairments.
